people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
translations.bsb: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
translations.kjv: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
translations.asv: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
